_note: This PDF is a bundled 6-page e-submittal packet, not a single form. Page 1 is a document-upload checklist (which attachments to include) - not applicant data, unmapped. Page 2 ('Building Permit Application', field suffix _A) is the actual generic application and the only page mapped here - it has an explicit 'DOES THE PROPOSED SCOPE INCLUDE SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC INSTALLATION?' Yes/No pair (Check Box3_A/A1), confirmed always-True for EcoSolar jobs. Pages 3-6 (RTO2024 electrical/plumbing/mechanical trade-item worksheet, a nested nan decision-tree page, an unrelated embedded 'frm41-66' form, and a final e-signature page) have no solar-specific content and no reliable JNB source - left entirely unmapped; staff/applicant handles them manually. On page 2: the ADU Yes/No pair (Check Box12_A/A1) is unmapped, same reasoning as every other 'is this an ADU' question this session - no reliable JNB signal. Of the top PERMIT TYPES APPLIED FOR row, only ELECTRICAL is mapped True (solar is always electrical work); RESIDENTAL/COMMERCIAL/STRUCTURAL/NON-STRUCTURAL/PLUMBING/MECHANICAL left unmapped, too ambiguous to guess. Sprinklers/A-C Yes-No (Check Box4/5) are the property's own existing conditions, not something JNB tracks - unmapped. The EXISTING BUILDINGS scope grid (INT ALT/EXT ALT/ADDITION/etc) is unmapped - out of scope for solar. Of the RESIDENTIAL classification grid (MODELS/PRODUCTION, SFD/DET CONDO, ATT CONDO/APT), only the SFD checkbox (Check Box12h_A) is mapped via solar_use.sfd, a reliable signal since EcoSolar jobs are essentially always single-family/townhome. Signature/date fields left blank (GUARDRAILS.md rule 3).
